sanskrit_verse:
मत्स्यादाश् च नराः पूर्वे व्यभिचाररताः स्त्रियः ।
उत्तरे मद्यपा नार्यः स्पृश्या नṝणां रजस्वलाः ॥
transliteration: matsyādāś ca narāḥ pūrve vyabhicāraratāḥ striyaḥ | uttare madyapā nāryaḥ spṛśyā nṝṇāṃ rajassvalāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the eastern regions, men who are unrighteous and women devoted to transgression shall not be touched; in the northern regions, women who drink intoxicants and are in their menstrual period shall remain untouched by men.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of spatial dharma over individual behavior
Causation through alignment with natural cycles and consciousness states
Capacity-based responsibility determined by regional and temporal dharmic context
Restoration logic rooted in separation from impure influences
Consciousness alignment through observance of purity codes
executable_legal_axioms: IF region = 'east' AND person.male AND conduct.vyabhicara THEN touch.restrict = true FOR all observers
IF region = 'north' AND person.female AND (conduct.intoxication OR state.menstruation) THEN contact.male = false FOR duration.of.state
IF violation.purity_code_detected THEN isolate.subject UNTIL state.purity.restored
IF observer.violates.restriction THEN awareness.review.triggered FOR observer.consciousness_state
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this axiom establishes jurisdictional variance in dharmic conduct regulation. The court must recognize that regional dharmic frameworks supersede generalized national law when dealing with purity-related offenses. Threshold of responsibility lies in acknowledgment of regional dharma by the accused. Restoration occurs via re-alignment with local purity protocols rather than punitive sentencing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through regional dharma śāstras. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential purification post-violation. Proportional responsibility aligns with degree of consciousness disruption caused. Non-punitive reality rule upheld: isolation and realignment replace incarceration or penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate consciousness review for violators to assess awareness deviation
Enforce temporary spatial segregation until purity is restored
Assign completion process involving ritual cleansing and dharmic study
Reintegrate subject upon verification of consciousness alignment with regional dharma
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored through spatial-temporal alignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
